# Dixon, Boles and Associates Family Dentistry

> A comprehensive family dental practice in Wilson, NC offering restorative, cosmetic, and orthodontic services for patients of all ages.

Dixon, Boles and Associates is a full-service dental practice led by Dr. Scott Dixon and Dr. Boles III, serving the Wilson, North Carolina community with a wide range of dental treatments including implants, Invisalign, and emergency care. The practice emphasizes patient education through their blog and maintains strict HIPAA compliance and accessibility standards.

## Key Topics

- Family Dentistry
- Restorative Dentistry
- Orthodontics
- Dental Implants
- Invisalign
- Cosmetic Dentistry
- Dental Crowns
- Emergency Dental Care
- TMJ Pain Treatment
- Tooth Extraction
- Gum Disease
- New Patient Welcome
- Wilson, NC
- HIPAA Compliance
- Comprehensive Care

## Core Services

- [Family Dentistry](https://wilsondentists.com/family-dentistry): Comprehensive family dentistry services for all ages in Wilson, NC
- [Restorative Dentistry](https://wilsondentists.com/restorative-dentistry): Restorative dentistry including implants, crowns, bridges, dentures
- [Orthodontics](https://wilsondentists.com/orthodontics): Orthodontic services including Invisalign and braces for all ages
- [Cosmetic Dentistry](https://wilsondentists.com/cosmetic-dentistry): Cosmetic dentistry services including teeth whitening and veneers
